metadata.short_desc: Toggle the watcher from the console and push dynamics to subscribed groups
metadata.desc: Bilibili dynamic watcher built on the Node library bilibili-user-simulation. The engine can only be toggled from the WebUI console; watching is unfiltered and the plugin filters per group, where an admin subscribes with /关注up <uid>.

console.title: Watcher Console
console.description: Start the engine, scan the login QR code, toggle watching/simulation, and inspect subscriptions and captured dynamics.
